policy: Assistant source-consistency audit, not clinician adjudication. Eight selected diagnostic probes per case; not exhaustive source or output claim inventories and not precision/recall. Demographics separated from clinical content. S=unambiguous supported fact, including explicitly identified events in history/discharge or neutral prose; P=readable fact with inappropriate clinical role (e.g. finding as surgery, outcome as treatment reaction); C=wrong value/entity/event/time/negation relation without a correct version of that same probed relation; X=correct and incompatible versions of the probed fact coexist; O=probed fact absent from all readable raw text; A=partial or ambiguous evidence. Synonymous headings, nested history and surgery/test dual use alone are not semantic errors. Probe labels concern the named subclaim, not all adjacent details; findings capture independent errors. Read malformed prefixes and arrays without repairing predictions or changing existing format scores. Absence of a reference/judge concern is not certification. Categories are diagnostic primary labels, not severity scores. Reference timing/causal/policy concerns and judge policy sensitivity are not all confirmed errors.

It omits the multicentric cancer, admission and reconstruction details, age and sex, and prior reduction history; it also invents a 69-inch height, weight, and BMI, duplicates the mastectomy, and misstates the flap location as at the latissimus rather than anterior to it.

The actual output captures the prior left nipple-sparing mastectomy history, flap anatomy, and breast asymmetry, but omits the multicentric cancer motivation, admission for immediate prepectoral reconstruction, patient age and sex, and prior reduction surgery. It also misses both staged reconstruction surgeries and their implant specifications and timing; the lipofilling rationale is altered, and the asymmetry’s upper-pole location and details are absent. Extra height and weight data do not match the expected patient facts.

The output captures the expander dimensions and prior breast reduction history, but it misstates the visit motivation and age, repeats an unsupported admission reason, and invents multiple symptoms, examinations, tests, and treatment timelines. It omits the expected 12-week implant exchange, contralateral reduction, flap details, and lipofilling rationale; the expected symptom is size asymmetry in the left upper pole, not the listed week-by-week symptoms.

The output captures the prior breast reduction history and the initial tissue expander dimensions, but misses the central visit motivation of multicentric left breast cancer and gives the wrong age (69 rather than sixty-three). It omits the exchange surgery at twelve weeks, contralateral reduction, specified 775 ml implant dimensions, later autologous flap details, and the upper-pole asymmetry symptom and its location. It also invents five timed symptoms, unrelated examinations/tests, and positive treatment reactions, while misplacing surgical details under medical history and treatments.
